description: This file defines a mutable builder class for creating ImmutableSearchResult objects, providing a fluent API for constructing search results with JSON array handling.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResultBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableSearchResult instances with JSON array support.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with default settings, including a no-next-page indicator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with properties from an existing SearchResult object.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the next page in the search result.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor string for the search result.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JsonValue objects to the internal JSON array.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonValue objects to the internal JSON array.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a JsonValue from the internal JSON array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableSearchResult object with the accumulated data.
